message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and drops NaN rows but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; there is no remote fetch and therefore no checksum, authentication, or integrity verification.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only drops NaN values and encodes labels via LabelEncoder; there is no check for label distribution anomalies, validation against an expected label set, or use of any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs only standard preprocessing (dropna, scaling, encoding) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code only trains models from scratch (no loading of pretrained weights or serialized models), so no hash/signature verification or controlled-source checks are implemented.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Keras/TensorFlow and scikit-learn optimizers with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) applied.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code; evaluation is limited to standard accuracy and F1/R2/MSE metrics.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test splitting is performed, the test set is not isolated or hashed, there is no signed evaluation data, and only a single evaluation run is done with no independent verification of metrics.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path directly indexes into X_test and passes the raw value to CAREExplainer with no shape, range, or schema validation on the input instance x_ord.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are used directly (predict, predict_classes, predict_proba) without any NaN guards, probability clipping, or sanity-bound checks before being returned or printed.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses tabular ML classifiers/regressors (MLP, GradientBoosting), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
